summary: Great Britain, Honshu, Java and Madagascar come fast; Luzon and Mindanao reward thought, Salsette (Mumbai's island) is the find, and Sri Lanka (#12), Ireland and Cuba are the near misses.
reasons: Builder's own replays, pending a real judge (the builder knew the answers when writing them). A casual order found 8 and lost its lives on Sri Lanka, Ireland, Cuba, Manhattan and Singapore; a player who doesn't think of Java or Sumatra finds 6.

Every island on the page with a figure (211), each from its latest census or estimate (2020-2024). #8 to #12 sit within 1.6 million of each other (Taiwan, Salsette, Borneo, Hispaniola, Sri Lanka), on figures of different years. Afro-Eurasia, the Americas and mainland Australia are unranked landmasses: free.

Five of the ten are also on islands (by area): Borneo, Madagascar, Sumatra, Honshu, Great Britain. Typing a country offers its islands ('japan', 'indonesia'); 'uk' is Great Britain, 'haiti' Hispaniola, 'mumbai' Salsette (Wikipedia's 'Mumbai Island'). Blitz not simulated.
